F10604

INSPECTION OF FUEL PRESSURE CONTROL SYSTEM

INSPECT VSV

A. Inspect VSV for Open Circuit

Using an ohmmeter, check that there is continuity between terminals.
Resistance: 30 — 50 Ω
If there is no continuity, replace the VSV.

[DIAGRAM showing ohmmeter connected to VSV]
F11917

B. Inspect VSV for Short Circuit

Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between each terminal and the body.
If there is continuity, replace the VSV.

[DIAGRAM showing "No continuity" measurement between VSV terminal and body]
F11918

C. Inspect VSV Operation

(a) Apply battery voltage across the terminals.
(b) Check that air flows from pipe E to air filter.

[DIAGRAM showing VSV connected to battery with Air inlet and Air Filter, indicating airflow]
F11919
